newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Taiwan awards second Aug naphtha cargo at $195/T.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan awards second Aug naphtha cargo at $195/T.

text.p: Taiwan's state-owned Chinese Petroleum Corp (CPC) has awarded a second cargo of naphthenic and aromatic naphtha (N+A) for August delivery at slightly above $195 per tonne cost-and-freight basis, a company official said on Friday.
The 28,000-tonne cargo is for delivery August 15-31 to Kaohsiung.
On Friday, CPC has awarded one 28,000 tonne cargo for August 1-15 delivery also to Kaohsiung at around $193 per tonne, cost and freight (c+f).
The tender closed on June 25 and was valid for two days.
CPC's last tender for July 20-31 delivery was awarded at slightly above $215 per tonne c+f Koahsiung.
